scope: New candidates only; existing 22 restored at user request.
review_method: Visual inspection of every candidate, then original-resolution inspection of accepted candidates. Check prompt fidelity, framing, anatomy, geometry, support/contact, lighting/reflections, and unwanted lettering. Ambiguous candidates withheld. This is manual qualitative selection, not a benchmark score or a guarantee of error-free images.
